title: 12 Best Literary Cafes and Bookshops Around Sofia's Slaveykov Square
description: Explore the best literary cafes and book market gems around Sofia's Slaveykov Square. Discover top picks for coffee, books, and charming atmospheres in the heart of the city.

places.name: Shatrata (The Tent)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bulgarian coffee (Turkish style) and a slice of cake.

places.name: La Catrina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Margarita or one of their refreshing homemade lemonades.

places.name: One More Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature Flat White or a craft cocktail from their extensive menu.

places.name: Dada Cultural Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A local craft beer or their daily special coffee, while enjoying the artistic atmosphere.

places.name: Coffee from Hell
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pour-over or a meticulously prepared espresso-based drink.

places.name: Griffin Bookshop (Книжарница Грифин)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their Bulgarian literature section for a unique souvenir, or find a new release from your favorite genre.

places.name: Vitamin B Bakery & Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Banitsa (savory pastry) with boza (a traditional fermented drink) for an authentic Bulgarian start to your day.

places.name: Barista Coffee & More
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their cold brew during the warmer months, or a classic cappuccino.

places.name: Pasta Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their freshly made pasta dishes; the Carbonara is particularly popular.

places.name: Knigomania (Книгомания) - Graf Ignatiev Branch
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for books on Bulgarian history, folklore, or travel guides to the region.

places.name: Chukura (Чукура)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the Kebapche (grilled minced meat) with a Shopska salad, or the Kavarma (slow-cooked meat stew).

places.name: Sweet Sofia (Сладкарница Sweet Sofia)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous chocolate cake or a slice of traditional Garash cake, paired with a freshly brewed coffee.
